# Joseph Zhu, CPA, CGA

> Joseph Zhu, CPA, CGA is a Vancouver accounting firm. Founder: Joseph Zhu, CPA, CGA (Zhixiong Zhu). Also known as Greenbeans CPA on Google (alternate name, pending final decision).
> Services in English and Chinese. Office: 3173 E 8th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5M 1X5, Canada.
> Phone: +1 604 728 1508. Email: ambitionvan@gmail.com. WeChat: YourTaxHelper.
> Note: The primary name is Joseph Zhu, CPA, CGA, matching the CPA BC Firm Directory. "Greenbeans CPA" is an alternate name only. The website domain is a temporary placeholder, pending a final decision. The address, phone, email, and services below are current.

## Services

- Corporate tax (T2): T2 returns, year-end financial statements, salary vs. dividend planning, CRA reviews and letters.
- Personal tax (T1): T1 returns, foreign property reporting (T1135), non-resident property sales, family tax planning.
- Bookkeeping, GST/PST and payroll: monthly bookkeeping from bank statements, GST/PST returns, payroll, T4 / T5 slips.
- DropBookAI bookkeeping: every bank line booked with its original document attached, CPA review, complete books on USB at year end.
